Chinese→English guidance:
- Syntax & referents: Break comma-chained clauses into crisp sentences with natural subordination; unpack pre-nominal modifiers (的-chains) and topic-comment openings. Match singular/plural, clarify ambiguous same-gender pronouns with a name, drop demonstrative 'that' before a name unless emphasizing distance/contrast, and render unlisted Chinese personal names in Pinyin (family name first, no tone marks).
- Address, numbers & register: Render titles, kinship/seniority terms, and exalted or humble self-references naturally for role, relationship, and setting—preferring natural 'I' with matching register over literal calques or repetitive third-person self-reference, steady per relationship unless it shifts. Convert exact 万/萬 (10,000) and 亿/億 (100 million) accurately; render figurative numbers (三五, 千军万马) idiomatically.
- Idioms & phrasing: Translate idioms (成语), allusions, and four-character phrases by meaning and effect. ${genre_zh_en_focus}
- Brackets, titles & dialogue punctuation: Render 【...】 as [...] for notices, labels, or prompts; render 《...》 in plain-text Title Case (or quotes for short works) without CJK brackets or Markdown asterisks; convert Chinese dialogue colons (说：“…”) to English commas or periods.
